load_causal_lm_model: load a causal language model from a Hugging Face repo path for text generation export to ExecuTorch
load_causal_lm_with_dtype: load a causal LM model with float16 dtype to reduce memory usage before exporting
load_causal_lm_with_gguf: load a causal LM model from a GGUF file for dequantized export to ExecuTorch
load_causal_lm_with_quantization: load a causal LM model with qlinear and qembedding quantization configs for export
load_causal_lm_with_custom_sdpa: load a causal LM model using custom SDPA attention and KV cache for export
